
	<h1 class="postTitle">
		<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/sunnyeveryday/p/19730331" title="发布于 2026-03-17 16:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">一种winform实时刷新日志内容的方法</span>
    

</a>

	</h1>
	
	<div class="postText">
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>做上位机，经常会有实时刷新日志内容的需求，比如接收串口消息、MQTT接收消息，常用的方法是<code>Invoke</code>函数 + <code>TextBox.AppendText</code>，比如</p>
<pre><code class="language-C#">Invoke((new Action(() =&gt;
{
	String msg = "串口消息" + Environment.NewLine;
    txtReceiveMessage.AppendText(string.Format("{0} - {1}",DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss"),msg));
})));
</code></pre>
<p>但是这种方式有两个弊端，一是日志长度靠<code>TextBox.MaxLength</code>属性控制，不能准确到行；二来消息只能逐个向后添加，不好调整顺序。</p>
<p>想要更灵活地刷新日志内容，可以使用<code>AsyncOperation</code>类与数据绑定功能。<br>
<a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/api/system.componentmodel.asyncoperation?view=net-8.0" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">AsyncOperation</a> ：C#中用来跟踪异步操作的生存期的类，其中的Post函数，可以从异步操作中向主进程发送消息。<br>
数据绑定：C#中一种非常强大的功能，它允许开发者将控件属性与数据源连接起来，实现自动更新和同步。<br>
默认情况下，绑定在TextBox、Label上的数据，只有在主进程上改动才能实时反应到界面上，跨线程操作会报错，这时则需要通过<code>AsyncOperation</code>类把“数据改动”这个消息发送到主界面上，才能正常展示，示例代码如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>先创建一个AsyncProperty类</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-C#">public class AsyncProperty : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    protected AsyncOperation operation;
    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

    public AsyncProperty()
    {
        operation = AsyncOperationManager.CreateOperation(null);
    }

	// 通过Post函数，将属性更改消息发送到主进程
    public void PostProperty(string propertyName)
    {
        operation.Post(new System.Threading.SendOrPostCallback(_ =&gt;
        {
            if (PropertyChanged != null)
                PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
        }), null);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>继承AsyncProperty类，创建一个日志类LogContent</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-C#">public class LogContent : AsyncProperty
{
    // 设置日志最大行数
    private int maxLine = 200;
    private int line = 0;
    private string _content = string.Empty;

    public string Content
    {
        get { return _content; }
    }

    public void InsertLog(string content)
	{
	    line++;
	    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
	    sb.Append(content);
	    sb.Append("\r\n");
	    if (line &gt; maxLine)
	    {
	        sb.Append(_content.Substring(0, indexOfNth(_content, maxLine, '\n', 1)));
	    }
	    else
	    {
	        sb.Append(_content);
	    }
	
	    _content = sb.ToString();
	    PostProperty(nameof(Content));
	}

    public void ClearLog()
    {
        line = 0;
        _content = string.Empty;
        PostProperty(nameof(Content));
    }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>把<code>LogContent.Content</code>绑定到TextBox.Text上即可</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-C#">public partial class Form1 : Form
{
    LogContent logContent;
    public Form1()
    {
        InitializeComponent();

        logContent = new LogContent();
        textBox1.DataBindings.Add("Text", logContent, nameof(logContent.Content));
    }

    private void btnLog_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        Thread thread = new Thread(WriteLog);
        thread.IsBackground = true;
        thread.Start();
    }

    private void WriteLog()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; 500; i++)
        {
            Thread.Sleep(100);
            logContent.InsertLog(DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmssfff"));
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>此时，跨线程调用的<code>WriteLog</code>函数，会将日志倒序实时刷新到界面上。</p>

</div>
